list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT hostname FROM monitor_host ORDER BY hostname

targets.rawSql: SELECT ms.collected_at AS "time", h.hostname AS metric, ms.value AS value FROM monitor_metricsample ms JOIN monitor_host h ON h.id = ms.host_id WHERE ms.metric_type = 'cpu' AND ms.sub_dimension = 'aggregate' AND ($__timeFilter(ms.collected_at)) AND ('$host' = 'All' OR h.hostname IN ($host)) ORDER BY ms.collected_at

SELECT cr.executed_at AS "time", h.hostname AS metric, cr.risk_score AS value FROM monitor_checkrun cr JOIN monitor_host h ON h.id = cr.host_id WHERE ($__timeFilter(cr.executed_at)) AND ('$host' = 'All' OR h.hostname IN ($host)) ORDER BY cr.executed_at
